headline: Togo Proposes Reducing Abidjan-Lagos Highway Cost to $10 Billion
summary: Togo proposed cutting the estimated cost of the planned Abidjan-Lagos highway from $15 billion down to $10 billion during a ministerial meeting in Lomé.
why: Large-scale infrastructure projects in West Africa reshape regional trade routes, lower logistics costs, and provide significant contract opportunities for construction and engineering firms.

impacts.name: Togo
impacts.why: Proposed cost reduction for a major regional highway project.
